title: Consultation
intro: Record the conversation. The transcript is a draft made by a speech engine; you review and correct it.
draftNote: Nothing here is final. Speakers are unknown until you set them.

consent.ok: Consent on record: audio recording and AI processing.

status.error: Recording stopped because of an error

error.mic_denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow microphone access in the browser, then try again.
error.mic_lost: The microphone stopped (it was unplugged or another program took it).
error.consent_withdrawn: Consent was withdrawn. Recording stopped and the audio held in this page was cleared.
error.spend_cap: This month's speech-service allowance is used up. Recording stopped.
error.idle_timeout: Recording stopped because no audio arrived for a while.
error.token: The recording could not be authorised. Open the consent screen and try again.
error.not_configured: The speech service is not set up on this server.
error.engine: The speech engine stopped. You can type notes and carry on.
error.protocol: Recording stopped because of a technical error.
error.connection_lost: The connection was lost and could not be restored. Recording stopped.

level.label: Microphone level
level.quiet: No sound is reaching the microphone. Check that the right microphone is selected and not muted.

run.noSpeech: No speech was recognised. The service heard {{heard}} s of audio and passed {{engine}} s to the speech engine after removing silence. Check the microphone level and try again.

save.error: Could not save. Trying again; you can also press Save now.
save.blocked: Not saved: consent for audio and AI processing is not on record.

confirm.title: Confirm this transcript?
confirm.body: Confirmed text becomes part of the record and can no longer be changed or deleted. Unconfirmed draft text is deleted if consent is withdrawn.
confirm.failed: The transcript could not be confirmed. Check that it is saved and consent is on record.

transcript.original: Original text from the speech engine
transcript.inMemory: Edits are kept on this screen only for now.

facts.title: Facts
facts.intro: Facts are suggestions taken from the saved transcript. Nothing is a fact until you confirm it. Nothing runs until you press the button.

blocked.unsaved: Wait until the transcript shows as saved.
blocked.consent: Audio and AI-processing consent are needed.

error.cap_reached: The usage limit for the language model has been reached. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: The language model is busy right now (rate limit). Try again in a minute.
error.model_unavailable: The language model could not be reached. Try again later.
error.real_data_blocked: A real language model is set up but is not allowed for this data. Nothing was sent.
error.consent: Consent is needed at this moment (audio and AI processing). Open the consent screen.
error.not_configured: The fact service is not set up on this server.
error.network: The fact service could not be reached.
error.other: The facts could not be extracted.
error.save: The change could not be saved. The list was refreshed.

facts.empty: No facts yet. Press Extract facts, or add one by hand.
facts.keys: Keyboard: with a fact focused, press C to confirm, R to reject, E to edit. These keys do nothing while you type.

concept.notLoaded: Concept list not loaded. No concepts are suggested.

error.load: Concept suggestions could not be loaded.
error.save: The concept change could not be saved.

pathway.aid: Suggestions are aids; the doctor decides.
pathway.noConsent: Audio and AI-processing consent is not on record, so the pathway aids are off and nothing is suggested.

error.load: The suggestions could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
error.save: That action could not be saved. The list was refreshed.

kept.title: Kept from before consent was withdrawn
kept.readOnly: These are the doctor's own decisions. They are shown read only.

questions.title: Suggested questions
questions.count: {{used}} handled so far; at most {{cap}} are suggested
questions.redFlagOpen: A pathway red-flag condition is met. Review it in the notice above.
questions.redFlagAcknowledged: Pathway red-flag condition acknowledged. The pathway makes no further suggestions while it applies.
questions.complete: No further questions from the pathway.
questions.conflict: Confirmed facts disagree for: {{slots}}. These count as unknown.

redFlag.title: Pathway red-flag condition met - doctor to review
redFlag.stays: This notice stays until you acknowledge it.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.none: No candidates yet. Confirm facts to see candidates.
candidates.noteLabel: Short note, in your own words
